summary: Make native operational SLO allowances and independent diagnostic aspirations explicit

replay.detail: Uses existing retained native evidence; diagnostic windows cannot backfill accounting history.

schema.detail: No new persisted schema or wire fields.

rules.detail: Retains the native platform's 5% latency, 1% transaction and 5% capacity-time allowances over 30d with cadence-aware paired burns.

compatibility.detail: Built-in objective descriptions explicitly distinguish operational slow-event and capacity-time allowances from p99/max aspirations. Row IDs, targets and evaluation remain unchanged.

manual.detail: Fleet owners bind native rows through their own declarations; public defaults carry no fleet identity.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior descriptions without changing evidence.
